hypothesis: An oversold stock that posts a positive day and regains MA5 may exhibit short-horizon market-relative mean reversion.
selection_reason: Represents a different mechanism from trend following, uses available point-in-time daily price fields, and provides price confirmation without adding a second volume hypothesis; selection did not use historical returns.
semantic_fix: Register a dedicated signal and emit it only when the complete oversold-reversal confirmation changes from false to true.
constraints: Use builtin default RSI, positive-day, MA5 confirmation, stop and exit definitions.
Execute each confirmation transition independently with T+1 fills and frozen costs.
Do not inspect the temporal test unless every training gate passes.
A failed baseline stops the default representation without RSI, return, MA or holding-period searches.
